# HawkAI
**Confidential · one-page venture proposal**

HawkAI is the live operating system for why the world is trending — and the campaign move that follows.

Repo: git@github.com:snagaram3/grokhackx.git · `feat/public-apis` @ `7077111`

## The problem

Every brand, newsroom, and growth team can see that something is trending. Almost none of them know why it is trending, who it is for, or what to ship before the peak. Social dashboards count hashtags. Terminals count tickers. Neither captures QR campaigns, short links, phrases, and URLs as they ignite across platforms — then translates that signal for kids through boomers and for the competitor sitting across the table. By the time a CMO sees the meme, the need underneath it has already moved.

## The solution

HawkAI is a plug-and-play category desk on live topics across X, Reddit, HN, and public APIs. Plug Markets or Weather or Campaigns — the same modules fill: current trends, a causation graph of measured drivers (first print, source heat, lag, artifacts — never an invented WHY), and an occurrence timeseries. The Booster Agent captures artifacts from real posts only, translates five age lenses, and arms competitors with hook, timing, and risk. The map is one more module. Booster turns attention into a campaign.

We do not sell another listening dashboard. We sell a category desk you plug in: why it is trending (measured, never invented), when it printed, who it lands on, and the campaign move that does not clone the meme. That loop is encoded in the Booster Agent and the live desk, not a slide.

## Why now

Attention fragments across platforms faster than any human war-room can staff. QR and short-link campaigns hide in the graph. Models can cluster; they still hallucinate a cause. We refuse that. Evidence-only correlation — hashtags, QRs, phrases, URLs, cashtags, with receipts — is the wedge, and it is already running.

## What's live

- **Live multi-source trend graph** — GET /api/trends clusters X, Reddit, HN, and public APIs with velocity + divergence
- **Natural-language Ask** — POST /api/ask answers live questions and zooms the matching topics
- **Booster intelligence API** — GET /api/booster returns artifacts, why-trending, age lenses, campaign moves
- **Plug-and-play category dashboard** — Drop in a category; trends, causation bars, and occurrence area chart fill from receipts
- **Category desk brain** — Classifies topics, graphs measured causation drivers, bins occurrence timeseries
- **Interactive D3 circle-pack map** — Full-viewport topic map; rising topics glow; click zooms to receipts
- **Per-topic campaign intelligence** — Hashtags, QRs, phrases, URLs, competitor hook, risk, five age takes
- **Capture → correlate → campaign loop** — Evidence-only WHY. Never invents posts or a fake cause.

## Agents

- **Booster Agent** — Capture artifacts, correlate why, five age lenses, competitor campaign moves.
- **PR Review Bot** — AI code review with 0-10 scoring and JSON/Markdown reports.
- **Bug Bot** — Security and logic scan used as a merge gate.
- **Docker CI Agent** — Production image build, smoke test, and Bug Bot on every PR and every merge to main.
- **SmartSalesGuy** — Checks out this repo and writes the VC one-pager from evidence only.

## What's next

- **Public-API ingest is offline** — News, weather, crypto, and sports receipts come from the public-apis catalog. Without them WHY stays social-only.
- **Ingest TikTok / Reels / Shorts caption text** — Almost no hashtags in HN/Reddit titles. Short-form campaigns are invisible.
- **QR image decode, not just QR-shaped URLs** — Campaigns hide the payload in images. Text regex cannot see a poster QR.
- **Audience toggle on the map** — The same rising cluster reads differently for family, 18–24, and a brand CMO.
- **News + disaster markers on the same timeseries** — GDELT and NWS land as receipts, but they are not lagged as event ticks against social velocity.
- **Export a one-page competitor brief** — CMOs will not live inside the circle pack. They want a PDF/Slack card.

The backlog is not a brainstorm. Booster re-ranks it from real capture gaps after every run.
